headline: Resume with 40–50 minutes easy
summary: Friday’s rest helped: readiness is 73 and recovery time is almost clear. Sleep was only 6h 05m, so keep today to 40–50 minutes easy at RPE 2–3, with walking or rest if tired.

recommendation.title: 40–50 minutes easy at RPE 2–3
details: Keep the whole run conversational on a flat or gently rolling route, roughly 6–8 km without chasing distance.
Cap the run at 50 minutes. No tempo, intervals, strides or fast finish.
Choose a cooler time of day and shorten the run if heat makes conversational effort difficult.
recommendation.alternative: 20–30 minutes relaxed walking or complete rest if sleepy, sore or unwell.
recommendation.reduce_or_stop: Stop for pain that changes gait, illness, unusual fatigue or dizziness. Seek urgent care for chest pain, fainting or severe breathlessness.

signals.interpretation: Keep duration moderate and prioritize a longer night before extending weekend distance.

signals.label: Recent running
signals.interpretation: There is useful endurance work already in the week; no need to compensate for Garmin’s low-load label.

caveats: Device measurements and classifications are Garmin data; the recommendation is coaching judgment.
Garmin’s recovery timer estimates readiness for another hard effort; it is not a ban on all movement.
Pain, illness, unusual sleepiness, dizziness and medical advice override device scores.
